# `mise doctor path`

- **Usage:** `mise doctor path [-f --full]`
- **Aliases:** `paths`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/doctor/path.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/doctor/path.rs)

Print the directories mise adds to PATH

Lists tool bin directories and `_.path` entries from [env]. --full prints the
whole PATH mise would set. `mise bin-paths` lists tool bin directories only.

## Flags
- **`-f --full`** — Print every PATH entry, including those mise does not provide
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Print the directories mise adds to PATH

```
mise doctor path
/home/user/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.11.0/bin
/home/user/.local/share/mise/installs/python/3.13.1/bin
```

Print the whole PATH mise would set

```
mise doctor path --full
```
